tal.belfry.a2.desc: Your skin turns to metal: more armour and 4% less damage taken.
tal.belfry.a2.name: Brass Skin
tal.belfry.a4a.desc: Bronze Ward returns 60% of damage you take as sonic damage.
tal.belfry.a4a.name: Resonant Ward
tal.belfry.a4b.desc: Bronze Ward lasts 10 s and grants speed, but its shield is smaller. It no longer repels.
tal.belfry.a4b.name: Mobile Bastion
tal.belfry.a6.name: Unbroken
tal.belfry.a7.desc: While Bronze Ward is active, taking damage unleashes a sonic wave that repels attackers (2.5 s).
tal.belfry.a7.name: Retort
tal.belfry.a8.desc: You convert 90% of damage taken into Toll, but your maximum life is reduced by 20%.
tal.belfry.a8.name: Converted Bronze
tal.belfry.a9.desc: Your Voices have +1 charge and you recover life on kill.
tal.belfry.a9.name: Iron Voice
tal.belfry.b2.desc: More sonic damage, area and Toll per hit.
tal.belfry.b2.name: Deep Toll
tal.belfry.b4a.desc: Peal opens a 10 m fissure in a line that hits everything it crosses.
tal.belfry.b4a.name: Seismic Fault
tal.belfry.b4b.desc: Peal strikes a second time half a second later for 60% damage.
tal.belfry.b4b.name: Double Peal
tal.belfry.b6.desc: Your slam attacks deal +25% damage and Unison gains area.
tal.belfry.b6.name: Resonant Mass
tal.belfry.b7.desc: The rings of Slow Toll contract toward you: they drag enemies in and the last one stuns.
tal.belfry.b7.name: Inverted Toll
tal.belfry.b8.desc: Toll no longer decays and Peal/Final Knell cost far less, but your maximum Toll is 60.
tal.belfry.b8.name: Perpetual Resonance
tal.belfry.b9.desc: Dissonance and other sonic states are stronger and last longer.
tal.belfry.b9.name: Long Echo
tal.belfry.c2.desc: Projectiles pierce one more enemy and deal +15% damage.
tal.belfry.c2.name: Chain Master
tal.belfry.c4a.desc: Chain Bell is no longer a projectile: it whirls around you for 5 s, striking whoever comes close.
tal.belfry.c4a.name: Orbiting Chain
tal.belfry.c4b.desc: Chain Bell drags much harder and may stun, but recharges more slowly.
tal.belfry.c4b.name: Heavy Drag
tal.belfry.c6.desc: The Full Chord deals +10% extra damage and lasts 1.5 s longer.
tal.belfry.c6.name: Beat Conductor
tal.belfry.c7.desc: Alarm Toll reaches 11 m, leaves enemies Vulnerable and cuts your attack cooldowns by 3 s.
tal.belfry.c7.name: War Alarm
tal.belfry.c8.desc: Every Full Chord casts a free Peal on the nearest enemy, but your Phrase lasts 1 s less.
tal.belfry.c8.name: Wandering Bell
tal.belfry.c9.name: Measured Step
tal.belfry.hub.desc: The starting point. Every path begins here.
tal.belfry.hub.name: Heart of the Clapper
tal.belfry.n_ear.desc: You hear farther, longer, and your Phrases last longer.
tal.belfry.n_ear.name: Absolute Pitch
tal.belfry.n_steady.desc: Full Chords return more Toll; cooldowns recover faster.
tal.belfry.n_steady.name: Steady Tone
tal.prismatist.a2.desc: Incandescent activates 10 points sooner and your spells deal +10% damage.
tal.prismatist.a2.name: Early Glow
tal.prismatist.a4a.desc: Prismatic Nova leaves a field of embers for 4 s.
tal.prismatist.a4a.name: Ember Nova
tal.prismatist.a4b.desc: Prismatic Nova is larger and drags enemies toward you.
tal.prismatist.a4b.name: Inverse Nova
tal.prismatist.a6.name: Focused Beam
tal.prismatist.a7.desc: Broken Beam lasts 5 s and hits harder, but builds more Radiance.
tal.prismatist.a7.name: Sustained Beam
tal.prismatist.a8.desc: Dazzle becomes a huge explosion (×3 damage, ×1.6 radius) and +15% damage overall. Use it wisely.
tal.prismatist.a8.name: Controlled Burst
tal.prismatist.a9.name: Free Channel
tal.prismatist.b2.desc: Your spells apply states more often and more potently.
tal.prismatist.b2.name: Sharp Refraction
tal.prismatist.b4a.desc: The Shard becomes a slow, large projectile that pierces every enemy.
tal.prismatist.b4a.name: Slow Shard
tal.prismatist.b4b.desc: The Shard explodes in an area on impact.
tal.prismatist.b4b.name: Burst Shard
tal.prismatist.b6.desc: Stronger Full Chord and deadlier critical hits.
tal.prismatist.b6.name: Chromatic Triad
tal.prismatist.b7.desc: At the end of its path, Ice Needle shatters into five splinters.
tal.prismatist.b7.name: Fractal Needle
tal.prismatist.b8.desc: Shard no longer refracts: it is always sonic, with +45% damage and +20% sonic damage.
tal.prismatist.b8.name: Perfect Prism
tal.prismatist.b9.desc: Damage-over-time states last longer and hit harder.
tal.prismatist.b9.name: Slow Flame
tal.prismatist.c2.name: Crystal Skin
tal.prismatist.c4a.desc: The Dome reflects part of damage taken, but no longer repels.
tal.prismatist.c4a.name: Reflective Dome
tal.prismatist.c4b.desc: The Dome scorches enemies that come close.
tal.prismatist.c4b.name: Blazing Dome
tal.prismatist.c6.desc: Your shields are stronger and you return some damage.
tal.prismatist.c6.name: Facets
tal.prismatist.c7.desc: The Chromatic Cascade follows you wherever you go.
tal.prismatist.c7.name: Wandering Cascade
tal.prismatist.c8.desc: Your maximum life is reduced by 35%, but you gain a huge shield that recharges out of combat.
tal.prismatist.c8.name: Crystal Body
tal.prismatist.c9.name: Double Flash
tal.prismatist.hub.name: Prism Core
tal.prismatist.n_ear.desc: You hear farther, longer, and your Phrases last longer.
tal.prismatist.n_ear.name: Absolute Pitch
tal.prismatist.n_steady.name: Serene Light
tal.skirmisher.a2.name: Hungry Edge
tal.skirmisher.a4a.name: Double Leap
tal.skirmisher.a4b.desc: Landing hits a larger area and stuns, at the cost of a longer cooldown.
tal.skirmisher.a4b.name: Brutal Landing
tal.skirmisher.a6.desc: Bleeds deal +20% damage and you heal with your hits.
tal.skirmisher.a6.name: Sweet Blood
tal.skirmisher.a7.desc: Bleeding Cut applies 3 stacks and costs 1 less Tempo, with less direct damage.
tal.skirmisher.a7.name: Deep Cut
tal.skirmisher.a8.desc: Bleeds deal +50% damage, but you take 10% more damage.
tal.skirmisher.a8.name: Crimson Fever
tal.skirmisher.a9.name: Thirst for Beat
tal.skirmisher.b2.desc: One more dodge charge and dodge more often.
tal.skirmisher.b2.name: Windfoot
tal.skirmisher.b4a.desc: At the end of the Slide you strike around you.
tal.skirmisher.b4a.name: Cutting Slide
tal.skirmisher.b4b.desc: Slide 9 m, with a slightly longer cooldown.
tal.skirmisher.b4b.name: Long Slide
tal.skirmisher.b6.name: Long Beat
tal.skirmisher.b7.desc: Leaf Dance lets you move at full speed and lasts longer, with less damage per hit.
tal.skirmisher.b7.name: Wandering Dance
tal.skirmisher.b8.desc: +10 maximum Tempo. Each perfect dodge throws free knives at the nearest enemy.
tal.skirmisher.b8.name: Endless Tempo
tal.skirmisher.b9.name: Breeze
tal.skirmisher.c2.desc: One additional projectile and traps deal more damage.
tal.skirmisher.c2.name: Long Hand
tal.skirmisher.c4a.desc: Throw five knives in a wider fan, each dealing less damage.
tal.skirmisher.c4a.name: Wide Fan
tal.skirmisher.c4b.desc: Throw a single fast knife that pierces 4 enemies for far more damage.
tal.skirmisher.c4b.name: Piercing Knife
tal.skirmisher.c6.desc: Traps and states are more potent.
tal.skirmisher.c6.name: Cord Hunter
tal.skirmisher.c7.desc: The snare covers more and blasts for double damage instead of rooting. Max 2.
tal.skirmisher.c7.name: Blast Snare
tal.skirmisher.c8.desc: +20% movement speed and enemies lose sight of you sooner, but your maximum life drops by 20%.
tal.skirmisher.c8.name: Swift Shadow
tal.skirmisher.c9.desc: More effective potions and a little more loot.
tal.skirmisher.c9.name: Scavenger's Eye
tal.skirmisher.hub.name: First Step
tal.skirmisher.n_ear.desc: You hear farther, longer, and your Phrases last longer.
tal.skirmisher.n_ear.name: Absolute Pitch
tal.skirmisher.n_steady.name: Steady Pulse
